title: The NA + hunts lead fixed: NA only from eval session 11, no NA once funded
question: ATLAS 2026-10-30 b: can a stage-aware member set (extra members by eval session / room / funded stage) keep the hunts' and the NA lead's money without breaking the 25K eval?
